chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The salat of the two 'Ids is obligatory, and the salat of the eclipse is obligatory.

key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two 'Id festivals, namely 'Id al-Fitr and 'Id al-Adha
key_terms.الْكُسُوفِ: the eclipse, for which a specific salat is prescribed
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: ritual prayer; the prescribed act of worship being discussed
key_terms.فَرِيضَةٌ: an obligatory duty established as legally binding

ai.seo_question: Is the salat of the two 'Ids and the salat of the eclipse obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat of the two 'Ids is a faridah, and that salat performed for an eclipse is also a faridah. It conveys a legal ruling concerning obligatory acts of worship in Shia fiqh.
